# Workflow Run Manifest Template
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Create this record at `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-manifest.md` before executing a stage. The populated record is Layer 4; this blank template is Layer 3.

```markdown
# Workflow Run Manifest
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

**Workflow:** [configured workflow path and name]
**Run:** [confirmed run path]
**Date:** [date]
**Request:** [user's outcome in plain language]
**Output root:** [confirmed path]
**Run type:** New / Continuation
**Prior run:** [path and outcome, or None]
**External handoff:** [source workspace, run path, and identifiers, or None]

## Confirmed Inputs

| Stage | Input | Resolved source | Detailed input record | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [stage] | [input] | [path, URL, identifier, or user-provided value] | [path or Manifest-only] | [Yes/No] |
```

The manifest is authoritative for confirmed run inputs. A stage writes `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/<stage>/inputs.md` only when its contract selects `Stage record required`; the manifest records that path. Keep any stage input record consistent with the manifest. A run with missing required sources must stop at its input gate.
